title: Shot-based quantum encoding: a data-loading paradigm for quantum neural networks
summary: Efficient data loading remains a bottleneck for near-term quantum machine learning. Existing schemes (angle, amplitude, and basis encoding) either underuse the exponential Hilbert-space capacity or require circuit depths that exceed the coherence budgets of noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware. We introduce shot-based quantum encoding (SBQE), a data embedding strategy that distributes the hardware's native resource, shots, according to a data-dependent classical distribution over multiple initial quantum states.
